item.title: St. Vital Centre Sold in $160.5M Deal
item.description: WINNIPEG -- St. Vital Centre has been acquired by a Canadian retail real estate firm for $160.5 million.

item.title: Province, United Way Winnipeg Commit to Multi-Year Funding in ‘For Every Family’ Program
item.description: United Way Winnipeg and the Manitoba government have announced a renewed, multi-year commitment to For Every Family, a community-led initiative that supports a network of family resource centres across Winnipeg.

item.title: Festival du Voyageur 2026 Kicks Off in Winnipeg
item.description: Festival du Voyageur officially opens today, marking the start of one of Manitoba’s largest and most iconic winter celebrations.

item.title: Manitoba to Contribute $1.2M to Black-Led Organizations
item.description: The Manitoba government is marking Black History Month with more than $1.2 million in funding for Black-led organizations in the province.

item.title: What’s Open and Closed in Winnipeg on Louis Riel Day
item.description: Here's a roundup of what's open, closed or operating on a reduced schedule on Louis Riel Day in Winnipeg on Monday, February 16.

item.title: Winnipeg Police Arrest Youth After Threats Targeting Elementary School
item.description: Winnipeg police have arrested a youth after an alleged threat towards a North End elementary school last week.

item.title: Festival du Voyageur Receives $325K Provincial Boost
item.description: WINNIPEG -- Festival du Voyageur is receiving $325,000 in funding from the provincial government just as the 57th annual event gets underway.

item.title: First Nation Buys Own Backup Generators, Saying Governments and Utility Failed Them
item.description: A Manitoba First Nation whose residents were evacuated for months last summer due to a wildfire and an extended power outage says it has bought its own backup generators, after it says governments and the province's Crown-owned electric utility failed them.

item.title: Security Guard Hospitalized After Being Robbed and Assaulted on Main Street
item.description: A man working as a security guard was taken to hospital after being robbed and struck with a weapon on Main Street on Friday.

item.title: Flooding at Winnipeg Police HQ Curtails Public Access
item.description: Winnipeg police have temporarily closed public access to their headquarters at 245 Smith Street after overhead pipes burst on Saturday evening.
